ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are four climate charts A, B, C, and D, and B is located in the upper right corner. The value range of the precipitation vertical axis in chart B is relatively low, and the column values throughout the year are generally very small, with relatively obvious column values appearing only around May—August; the curves and column information representing evaporation are also overall relatively low, with only a brief summer slightly strengthening. Reasoning: This kind of characteristic of being cold throughout the year, having little precipitation, and only having slightly obvious water-heat activity in a brief summer conforms to the identification characteristics of polar climate. Therefore, the climate type represented by B is polar climate.

method.method_draft: 先在图中定位标有“乙”的右上角小图；观察该图纵轴数值低、全年降水量很少，只有夏季短暂月份有较明显柱状值，蒸发量也很低。根据“极地气候全年寒冷、降水稀少、只有短暂夏季活动明显”的判别规则，将乙判定为极地气候。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有甲、乙、丙、丁四个气候图，乙位于右上角。乙图的降水量纵轴数值范围较低，全年柱状值总体很少，仅在5—8月附近出现较明显的柱状值；表示蒸发量的曲线和柱状信息也整体偏低，只有短暂夏季略有增强。
推理：这种全年寒冷、降水稀少，只有短暂夏季水热活动稍明显的特征，符合极地气候的判别特征。因此，乙表示的气候类型是极地气候。
